hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Mill
function: The cutting tool on the motor that grinds each composite frac plug into pieces small enough to circulate out.

tabs.overview: Dressed with carbide or hardfacing; diameter slightly under the casing drift; profile chosen for composite plugs.
tabs.engineering: Diameter per the casing; hours per mill tracked.
tabs.safety: Worn mills slow the drillout and leave larger debris.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
